bio.text: Ralph Ambrosio, a Republican from Delmar, announced in January 2026 that he would challenge Rep. Paul Tonko in New York's 20th Congressional District, according to Spectrum News.
Spectrum reported that he is a Navy veteran and attorney who worked for the State Police and as an assistant attorney general under former Attorney General Dennis Vacco.
He was born in Hudson and raised in Chatham, Spectrum reported.

sources.title: Republican announces plans to challenge Tonko in NY-20
